ctx.x: because it makes plenty of people lazy. Did you like to work when you were 14? Yeah, I like to work. I used to go to work with a good heart. And what kind of work were you doing?

Well, I was helping me in a blacksmith shop. First, I was in a drug school, getting 50 cents a day, 50 cents a week to go deliver orders of the druggish. What did your parents do, your father and your money? Well, my father drove a team of horses. Well, they delivered a delivery wagon. I'll tell you what, like this Wilson and Company or Homo people. Well, he worked for a company of that sort, but sold wholesale meats. I mean, deliver. We can stop it. He's consigned. I used to deliver this meat at night. What was…
Yeah, that's something different. That's something different. So, in other words, you didn't go into your father's business?
